name: Sofia Rahman
household: Lives with extended family, sends money home
psychographics: Hustle-culture believer who tracks every taka; treats freelance income as a household survival fund, not personal spending money
current_solutions: Uses Bkash for instant payments, Canva for design, and a spreadsheet that tracks daily earnings by hour
frustration: At 11:00 PM on a Saturday, tried to transfer 5,000 Taka to her sister's bKash account using the mobile app, but the server was down for maintenance, leaving her unable to send the rent contribution and causing a shouting match with her mother an hour later
decision_style: Only pays for apps with a clear, immediate ROI; deletes any subscription that doesn't show a tangible benefit within the first month
voice: Fast-paced, heavy on mobile slang. Mixes English and Bangla phrases mid-sentence. Uses 'literally' and 'honestly' as filler words constantly
